test_cases.scenario: Add an in-stock product to an empty cart
preconditions: Cart is empty and the cart count shows 0
steps: Open the 'Blue Mug' product details page
test_cases.expected_result: The cart count changes from 0 to 1 and the cart contains exactly one product, 'Blue Mug'

test_cases.scenario: 'Add to Cart' button is visible and clickable for an in-stock product
steps: Open the 'Blue Mug' product details page
Hover over and click the button
test_cases.expected_result: The 'Add to Cart' button is displayed, enabled, and responds to the click by adding the product (cart count increases by 1)

test_cases.scenario: Cart shows the added product's name, price and quantity matching the product page
preconditions: User is logged in with an empty cart
steps: Open the 'Blue Mug' product details page and note the displayed name and price
test_cases.expected_result: The cart line shows name 'Blue Mug', price ₹499.00 (identical to the product page) and quantity 1

test_cases.scenario: Price with decimals and thousands separator is shown exactly in the cart
preconditions: User is logged in with an empty cart
Product 'Desk Lamp Pro' priced ₹1,299.50 has stock 5
steps: Open the 'Desk Lamp Pro' product details page
test_cases.expected_result: The cart shows price ₹1,299.50 for 'Desk Lamp Pro' with no rounding, truncation or currency change

test_cases.scenario: Add a different product to a cart that already has items
preconditions: Cart contains 'Blue Mug' only and the cart count shows 1
steps: Open the 'Desk Lamp Pro' product details page
test_cases.expected_result: The cart count changes from 1 to 2; the cart lists 'Blue Mug' and 'Desk Lamp Pro', each with its own name, price and quantity, and 'Blue Mug' is unchanged

test_cases.scenario: Out-of-stock product cannot be added and a message is shown
preconditions: Cart contains 'Blue Mug' only and the cart count shows 1
steps: Open the 'Red Lamp' product details page
test_cases.expected_result: A message stating 'Red Lamp' is out of stock is displayed; the cart count stays 1 and the cart still contains only 'Blue Mug'

test_cases.scenario: Product with exactly 1 unit in stock (last unit) can be added
preconditions: User is logged in with an empty cart
steps: Open the 'Green Vase' product details page
test_cases.expected_result: No out-of-stock message is shown, the cart count changes from 0 to 1 and the cart contains 'Green Vase'

test_cases.scenario: Product goes out of stock while its details page is open
preconditions: User is logged in with an empty cart
A second test account is available to buy the last unit
steps: As the user, open the 'Green Vase' product details page and leave it open
Using the second account, purchase the last 'Green Vase' so its stock becomes 0
Without reloading, as the user click 'Add to Cart'
test_cases.expected_result: The out-of-stock message is displayed, the cart count stays 0 and 'Green Vase' is not in the cart

test_cases.scenario: Added product remains in the cart after reloading the page
preconditions: User is logged in with an empty cart
steps: Open the 'Blue Mug' product details page
test_cases.expected_result: After the reload the cart count still shows 1 and the cart still contains 'Blue Mug'

test_cases.scenario: Adding the same product a second time
preconditions: Cart contains 'Blue Mug' with quantity 1 and the cart count shows 1
steps: Open the 'Blue Mug' product details page
test_cases.expected_result: The cart count changes from 1 to 2 and the total quantity of 'Blue Mug' in the cart is 2
test_cases.notes: Whether this is one line with quantity 2 or two lines is not specified (Q-2); only the totals are asserted.

gaps.description: Behaviour for users who are not logged in
gaps.reason: The requirement covers logged-in users only; guest behaviour is undefined (Q-4). All cases use a logged-in precondition.

gaps.description: Quantity selection, maximum quantity per product and maximum cart size
gaps.reason: No quantity selector or numeric limits are specified (Q-1), so no quantity validation or boundary cases can be written without inventing rules
AC 6 only says 'appropriate message' (Q-3); cases assert that an out-of-stock message appears

gaps.description: Rapid double-click, session expiry before clicking, sale/discounted prices in the cart

coverage_summary.notes: All 6 acceptance criteria are covered: the happy path, the cart count from 0 and from a non-empty cart, data checks in the cart, and out-of-stock blocking, including the stock 1/0 boundary and stock running out while the page is open. Four cases depend on assumptions A-1 to A-3. The biggest gaps are guest behaviour (Q-4) and the absence of quantity rules (Q-1), which limit boundary and validation coverage.

requirements.text: A logged-in user can add an available product to the shopping cart from the product details page

acceptance_criteria.text: User can click the 'Add to Cart' button
The selected product is added to the cart
Product name, price and quantity are displayed correctly in the cart
Out-of-stock products cannot be added to the cart
User sees an appropriate message when adding an out-of-stock product

business_rules.text: Adding to cart is specified for logged-in users only
